purpose: Deterministically check mobile-width navigation coherence against desktop module visibility at a pinned viewport width.
preconditions: Sandbox build identity verified against the approved SHA.
Module visibility is at its default/restored state (no fixture toggles active).

steps.action: Set the browser viewport/window width to 390 px.
steps.expect: The layout switches to the mobile navigation surface.

steps.action: Inspect the navigation surface at mobile width.
steps.expect: Primary navigation remains reachable and coherent with desktop module visibility; no unreachable or hidden-only-in-mobile entries.

steps.action: Return the viewport/window to desktop width.
steps.expect: The desktop navigation groups render again.

expected.navigationState: mobile navigation surface renders and stays coherent with desktop module visibility

blockedFallback: If native window resize is unavailable, grade this row BLOCKED and record the exact blocker; do not simulate a mobile width by zoom or claim coverage from desktop-width evidence.
forbidden: Disturbing other windows or user sessions while resizing.
Entering credentials or approving permission prompts.
